def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    bg=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=grid[i][j]
            if v==2: p=[1,5,5,5,5]
            elif v==9: p=[1,3,3]
            else: continue
            s=j-len(p)//2
            for k,x in enumerate(p):
                q=s+k
                if 0<=q<w and grid[i][q]==bg: out[i][q]=x
    return out
